spec.description: Full-year season audit on v7.5 after the code review (364c23f): lake, ocean and brook forts, spring -> summer -> autumn -> winter -> next spring (four changes, 2,000 ticks past the fourth: the new year), 1 replicate, DF restarted for every fort. Measured as X3v75c (off-cast arrivals per layer and season, in-cast send-offs, depth send-offs, wrong-depth cavern arrivals, send-offs gone in 10 days, reserve conservation, created-entry arrivals, keep-alive writes, hangs), now across the winter casts and the year turn, with cast predators armed (F13 live again).
